# RHWP Exact Kerning Smoke Fixture

`RHWPExactKerningSmoke.ttf` and `RHWPExactKerningSpaceSmoke.ttf` (which adds
`pos space A -80; pos V space -80;`) are generated by
`scripts/generate_exact_kerning_fixture.py` from the deterministic synthetic
GPOS face used by the public Issue #4968 capability boundary. All glyph
outlines and metadata are original test data released under the repository's
MIT license.
